Warehouses.title: Warehouses & locations
Warehouses.body: The structure of your stock: warehouses with their nested locations, so every movement carries an explicit place and on-hand can be read per location. On the left the warehouse list with default and status; on the right the selected warehouse's location tree and its on-hand by location. Creating and editing happen in the side drawer; archived warehouses disappear from the pickers while their history remains.
